title: Symbols on the joined tape
statement: Given a finite list of finite lists of symbols and an integer position $z$, the tape contains the symbol at position $z$ in the joined encoding when $z\ge 0$ and that position holds a symbol; it is blank when $z<0$, the position is outside the encoding, or the position is a separator.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of finite lists of symbols
